frames.physical_state_en: Door is fully latched and flush closed. Broad intact blue hem ends in the trailing seam. Man LEFT hand tests that hem, RIGHT empty down; heroine both hands down.
frames.acting_en: Man looks directly at the caught hem with a pinched brow and concentrated closed mouth; heroine's gaze is on the seam, not his face. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Man LEFT gives one extra restrained tug with planted feet and braced torso. Door remains latched, broad woven cloth continuous, RIGHT empty down.
frames.acting_en: Man briefly puffs cheeks for the restrained extra tug; heroine's eyes shift from trapped cloth to the exterior handle with one subtle raised brow. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Door remains closed and hem trapped. Heroine RIGHT fingers grip actual exterior handle; LEFT down. Man stops tugging but lightly holds hem with LEFT.
frames.acting_en: Man stops exerting and watches her RIGHT hand on the handle; heroine focuses on the latch, keeping a neutral mouth. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Door is slightly open outward and the same intact shirt corner is visibly free in man LEFT hand. Heroine RIGHT remains on exterior handle.
frames.acting_en: Only after the seam opens does the man's brow release as he looks at his now-free hem; heroine watches the clearance carefully. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Door holds the same small opening. Man LEFT moves all free broad cloth toward own hip, leaving a visible gap from the empty closing seam. Her RIGHT holds handle.
frames.acting_en: Man looks at the fabric he brings clear, a small raised brow marking recognition; heroine keeps a focused safety-check gaze on the empty seam. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: After full cloth clearance, the door is flush closed again. All shirt fabric stays outside. Heroine RIGHT has withdrawn and both hands are down.
frames.acting_en: With door closed again, man glances from handle to intact free cloth, expression softer; heroine's hands are down and face calm. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Man LEFT smooths the same intact free hem; RIGHT down. Heroine empty hands stay down, with no mutual hand contact; door remains closed.
frames.acting_en: Man smooths his own shirt with a small downward pressed-lip sheepish smile; heroine allows a tiny patient smile, without a long mutual gaze. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Door stays closed and shirt hangs free. Heroine two empty flat palms are together at lower sternum, settled after one small bow; man hands empty down.
frames.acting_en: Heroine settles after a shallow bow with joined flat palms and soft eyes; man stands relaxed, shirt intact and clearly outside the closed seam. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
